mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `cors`.`shop_info` ( user_email, shop_name, shop_time, shop_category, shop_address, shop_tel, profile_image, background_image ) VALUES ( #{info.userEmail}, #{info.shopName}, #{info.shopTime}, #{info.shopCategory}, #{info.shopAddress}, #{info.shopTel}, #{info.profileImage}, #{info.backgroundImage} )
mapper.select: SELECT shop_id AS shopId, user_email AS userEmail, shop_name AS shopName, shop_time AS shopTime, shop_category AS shopCategory, shop_address AS shopAddress, shop_tel AS shopTel, profile_image AS profileImage, background_image AS backgroundImage FROM `cors`.`shop_info` WHERE user_email = #{email}

SELECT shop_id AS shopId, user_email AS userEmail, shop_name AS shopName, shop_time AS shopTime, shop_category AS shopCategory, shop_address AS shopAddress, shop_tel AS shopTel, profile_image AS profileImage, background_image AS backgroundImage FROM `cors`.`shop_info` WHERE /* 최소한 '대구시' 같은 큰 지역은 맞아야 검색되도록 설정 */ `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') ORDER BY /* 정렬 로직 (점수 매기기) */ (CASE /* 1순위: "대구시 달서구" (구까지 일치하면 가장 위) */ WHEN `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT(#{address}, '%') THEN 2 /* 2순위: "대구시" (시만 일치해도 그 다음) */ WHEN `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT(#{region}, '%') THEN 1 /* 그 외 */ ELSE 0 END) DESC, `shopId` DESC

SELECT shop_id AS shopId, user_email AS userEmail, shop_name AS shopName, shop_time AS shopTime, shop_category AS shopCategory, shop_address AS shopAddress, shop_tel AS shopTel, profile_image AS profileImage, background_image AS backgroundImage FROM `cors`.`shop_info` WHERE /* 최소한 '대구시' 같은 큰 지역은 맞아야 검색되도록 설정 */ `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') ORDER BY /* 정렬 로직 (점수 매기기) */ (CASE /* 1순위: "대구시 달서구" (구까지 일치하면 가장 위) */ WHEN `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT(#{address}, '%') THEN 2 /* 2순위: "대구시" (시만 일치해도 그 다음) */ WHEN `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT(#{region}, '%') THEN 1 /* 그 외 */ ELSE 0 END) DESC, `shopId` DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT shop_id AS shopId, user_email AS userEmail, shop_name AS shopName, shop_time AS shopTime, shop_category AS shopCategory, shop_address AS shopAddress, shop_tel AS shopTel, profile_image AS profileImage, background_image AS backgroundImage FROM `cors`.`shop_info` WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT t1.shop_id AS shopId, t1.user_email AS userEmail, t1.shop_name AS shopName, t1.shop_time AS shopTime, t1.shop_category AS shopCategory, t1.shop_address AS shopAddress, t1.shop_tel AS shopTel, t1.profile_image AS profileImage, t1.background_image AS backgroundImage, t2.created_at AS likedAt FROM cors.shop_info AS t1 INNER JOIN cors.like_shops AS t2 ON t2.shop_id = t1.shop_id WHERE t2.user_email = #{userEmail} ORDER BY t2.created_at DESC

SELECT shop_id AS shopId, user_email AS userEmail, shop_name AS shopName, shop_time AS shopTime, shop_category AS shopCategory, shop_address AS shopAddress, shop_tel AS shopTel, profile_image AS profileImage, background_image AS backgroundImage /* 콤마(,) 제거됨 */ FROM `cors`.`shop_info`
ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cors`.`like_shops` WHERE `shop_id` = `cors`.`shop_info`.`shop_id`) DESC, `shopId` DESC
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT(#{address}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN `shop_address` LIKE CONCAT(#{region}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, `shop_address` ASC, `shopId` DESC
LIMIT #{page.rowCount} OFFSET #{page.dbOffset}

SELECT si.shop_id AS shopId, si.user_email AS userEmail, si.shop_name AS shopName, si.shop_time AS shopTime, si.shop_category AS shopCategory, si.shop_address AS shopAddress, si.shop_tel AS shopTel, si.profile_image AS profileImage, si.background_image AS backgroundImage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cors`.`like_shops` ls WHERE ls.shop_id = si.shop_id) AS likeCount FROM `cors`.`shop_info` si
FIND_IN_SET(#{category}, REPLACE(si.shop_category, ' ', ''))
ORDER BY likeCount DESC, si.shop_id DESC
